about.title: About ProjectName
about.intro: ProjectName is a collection of free online tools — calculators, text utilities, generators, and developer utilities — that run entirely in your browser.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Most online tools require sign-ups, process your data on their servers, or are cluttered with ads. We build simple, fast utilities that respect your privacy. Everything runs locally — nothing is uploaded, stored, or tracked.

points.free: 100% free — no paywalls, no hidden fees, no accounts.
points.fast: Built with Next.js and React, tools load instantly on any device.
points.private: All calculations happen in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Short version: we don't collect, store, or share your personal data. Everything runs in your browser.

data.title: What data we collect
data.text: None. All tools run entirely in your browser using client-side JavaScript. Calculations, file conversions, text processing — everything happens on your device. Nothing is sent to our servers.

storage.title: Local storage
storage.text: Some tools use your browser's localStorage to remember your preferences (for example, theme choice). This data stays on your device and is never transmitted.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: We may use privacy-friendly analytics to understand which tools are popular. This data is aggregated and cannot identify you personally.

thirdparty.title: Third-party services
thirdparty.text: We may display non-intrusive ads via Google AdSense to keep the service free. These ads follow Google's own privacy policy, independent of us.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.text: If we update this policy, we'll change the date above. Continued use of the site means you accept the updated policy.

contact.title: Contact
contact.text: Questions about privacy? Get in touch.

bmi-calculator.title: BMI Calculator – Body Mass Index
bmi-calculator.description: Free BMI calculator. Check your Body Mass Index instantly, see weight category, and healthy weight range.

faq.a1: BMI (Body Mass Index) is a measure of body fat based on height and weight.
faq.a2: No. BMI does not distinguish muscle from fat. Athletes may have high BMI but low body fat.
faq.a3: For most adults, a BMI between 18.5 and 24.9 is considered healthy.

calorie-calculator.title: Calorie Calculator – Daily Calorie Needs
calorie-calculator.description: Calculate your daily calorie needs based on age, gender, height, weight, and activity level.

faq.a1: TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) is the total number of calories you burn per day.
faq.q2: How many calories should I eat to lose weight?
faq.a2: A common recommendation is a deficit of 300–500 kcal/day for steady weight loss.

age-calculator.title: Age Calculator – Exact Age in Years, Months, Days
age-calculator.description: Free age calculator to find your exact age in years, months, and days. Calculate age as of any date.
age-calculator.keywords: age calculator,how old am i,date of birth

hints.targetDate: Leave empty to use today's date.

faq.a1: Age is calculated by subtracting the birth date from the target date, accounting for month lengths.
faq.q2: Can I calculate age on a future date?
faq.a2: Yes. Enter any target date to see how old you will be.
